text:
harper: Quick heads-up — onboarding vela9b-int4 into dedicated pool. Canary had 2 OOMs on long exports (~900-1200 tokens). Logs show kv_alloc spikes and slab fragmentation ~0.44. Anybody have a short mitigation checklist?

lucas: Can you paste a log snippet and the serving.yml you used? initial hunch: mixing short/long requests + lazy compaction.

harper: Log + config: 
```
[2026-07-12T10:05:08Z] req=aa11 model=vela9b-int4 max_new_tokens=1024 batch=4 seq_ctx=64 mem_delta=+3.7GB slab_frag=0.44
[2026-07-12T10:05:08Z] gpu0: OOM at kv_alloc serving/allocator/slab.cc:302
[2026-07-12T10:05:08Z] fallback: prefix_evict reclaimed=48MB; retry -> slow success
```
serving.yml used: 
```yaml
model: vela9b-int4
batching:
  max_batch_size: 4
  batch_timeout_ms: 10
  allow_variable_lengths: true
runtime:
  max_new_tokens_default: 1024
  kv_eviction: lazy
  slot_compaction: disabled
```

perf-bot: Canary snapshot: p50=145ms p95=370ms p99=1.9s OOMs=2/45m avg_tokens=480

anika: Short ops fixes that usually work: lower max_batch_size to 2, enable length bucketing, enable slot_compaction and set slab_soft_reserve=400MB, switch eviction to eager. Also consider lowering max_new_tokens_default to 320 for int4.

lucas: I'll roll a small canary patch: 
```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_size: 2
  length_bucketing: true
  batch_timeout_ms: 6
runtime:
  max_new_tokens_default: 320
  kv_eviction: eager
  slot_compaction: enabled
  slab_soft_reserve: 400MB
```
Rolled at 10:15.

deploy-bot: Deploy vela9b-int4 v2026-07-12T10:15 by lucas -> canary-pool

perf-bot: Update @10:40: p99=1.05s OOMs=0/30m slab_frag=0.31 mem_headroom +1.1GB

anika: Quick quality sanity: ran 200 long-form summarization prompts. int4 rougeL gap vs fp16 = -1.4 pts with these defaults (was -2.8 before). Latency p95 +~4% due to compaction. Seems acceptable.

harper: Filed tickets ML-12100 (defaults + rollout) and ML-12101 (quant sweep int4 vs int8-hybrid). Added on-call SOP: if OOMs return -> set max_batch_size=1, max_new_tokens_default=128, enable immediate compaction and escalate.

lucas: Plan: set model defaults to the patched values, add per-route opt-in for long runs that routes to fp16 with warning, and run quant sweep for 48h.

(End)
